content.name: Leyla Demir
content.title: Executive Assistant to the Managing Director
content.summary: Executive assistant with 14 years of office and management support in logistics, real estate and maritime consulting in Hamburg. Trained as a Bürokauffrau and later qualified as a Wirtschaftsfachwirtin (IHK); now runs the managing director's office, a two-person assistant team and events for international clients in German, English and Turkish.

experience.title: Bürokauffrau (Office Administrator)
bullets: Processed incoming freight invoices and delivery notes in SAP for a depot handling around 900 shipments a week.
Took over the scheduling of driver training and medical check-ups, so no certificate lapsed during my time there.
Answered German and Turkish customer calls about delivery status and complaints, passing tricky cases to dispatch with full notes.

experience.title: Team Assistant, Commercial Lettings
bullets: Supported a team of seven letting agents with viewings, exposés and lease drafts for office space across the city.
Created a tracking sheet for lease break dates and rent indexation clauses covering 140 commercial tenancies.
Organised the company's stand at a regional real estate fair, coordinating suppliers on a €35,000 budget.
Studied part-time for the Wirtschaftsfachwirtin (IHK) qualification while working full-time.

experience.title: Executive Assistant to the Managing Director
bullets: Run the managing director's office: diary, correspondence, board preparation and travel to around 20 countries a year.
Lead two team assistants and set up shared standards for templates, filing and handovers across the 45-person firm.
Moved all contract and supplier filing to a DMS with clear access rights, making GDPR (DSGVO) requests quicker to answer.
Plan the annual client conference for 150 guests, including venue, speakers and simultaneous interpretation, within a €90,000 budget.
Prepare monthly cost-centre reports in Excel for the management team, catching mis-coded invoices worth about €18,000 in one year.

education.details: Advanced vocational qualification in business management

education.school: Elbtal Logistik GmbH and Berufliche Schule City Nord

achievements.title: Trainer for apprentices
achievements.detail: Holds the AEVO trainer qualification and has guided two Kauffrau für Büromanagement apprentices to their final exam.

achievements.title: Conference rebuild
achievements.detail: Turned a one-day client meeting into a two-day conference with 30% more attendees than the previous format.
